state.seed_assertion: Indiscriminate packet capture should be avoided as the first step; instead begin with the failing connection and time window.

sentences.1: Indiscriminate packet capture should be avoided as the first step;
sentences.2: instead begin with the failing connection and time window.
sentences.3: Avoid indiscriminate packet capture as the first step.
sentences.4: Begin with the failing connection and time window, then collect targeted traffic if switch and device diagnostics cannot distinguish the cause.
sentences.5: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.
sentences.6: Continuity checks are useful for wiring verification but only with the circuit de-energised.
sentences.7: Trying to run a continuity test on a live 24 VDC circuit will give you a beep regardless of the fault because the meter's test current is swamped by the supply.
sentences.8: Using continuity mode on a live circuit produces false positive 'good' results due to the supply voltage overwhelming the meter's test current.
